comments.author: 3JPLW
comments.story: Python Tools for Visual Studio 2.0 Beta
comments.why: Documents mixed-mode debugging introduced in the beta
comments.text: Two highlights from the release notes: - Starting with VS2013, we’re happy to announce that PTVS is “in the box”. This means when you install Visual Studio, there is a an existing “Python” download link which will install PTVS for you. - Mixed-mode debugging! Alpha introduced remote debugging on Linux and MacOS. Beta introduces mixed Python and C/C++ debugging. Please refer to the documentation or this video: [VIDEO]
